periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Approximately 45 degrees oblique, sloping downward from the lateral temple region toward the medial muzzle.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval; the major axis is approximately 1.5 times the length of the minor axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced tapering at the inferior-medial margin toward the nasal bridge.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow, wide U-shaped curvature at the posterior boundary.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: The dark band occupies approximately 25% of the visible cranio-caudal torso length from this dorsal perspective.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide gap; the inter-ear distance is approximately equal to the horizontal width of a single ear.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, semicircular convex curvature at the superior margins.
